groups.reason: Unique issue: weekly digest email leaks wrong team's aggregate stats to dual-team members; no other candidate describes this symptom.

All four describe the identical symptom: in-browser coaching session video freezes to a still frame around the 40-minute mark on Chrome while audio keeps playing, with a page refresh restoring video, following a recent period of stability. Same platform (Chrome), same failure mode, same timing window - clearly the same underlying defect reported by different customers.
Unique feature request for custom profile fields (cost center, region, business unit, employee type) with backfill and export support.

Unique bug: bulk CSV import silently drops rows containing non-Latin (kanji/katakana) characters in the name field with false success reporting - a distinct failure mode from the trailing-whitespace header rejection bug (call-136#f0), which fails the entire file rather than silently dropping specific rows.

All three describe the same defect: coach-search filters (language/specialty/timezone) are cleared when a user navigates back via the browser back button from a coach profile, forcing re-entry and causing search abandonment. Same page, same trigger, same symptom across different accounts.
Unique feature request to let members export/download their own session notes, gated by org policy.

Both describe goal-tracking reminder notifications firing around 2:30-3:30am local time for APAC members, attributed to a fixed US-business-hours absolute send time rather than per-member timezone adjustment. Same root cause, same symptom, same affected population type (APAC).

Unique bug: bulk member deactivation times out on large batches, leaves non-atomic partial state with no success/failure report. Distinct from the coach-reassignment bulk-action gap (no bulk deactivate failure there) and from the CSV-import bugs.

All three request the same underlying capability: a callable REST API (or BI connector) exposing aggregate, org/team-level engagement and utilization metrics for ingestion into BI tools (Tableau/Power BI/Looker) on a schedule, replacing manual screenshotting/retyping. Same ask, same scope (aggregate not individual), same delivery mechanism (API/connector) - distinct from call-107#f0 which explicitly requires an automated SFTP push and explicitly rejects an API-pull as insufficient, and distinct from call-069#f0 which is specifically about a privacy-preserving suppressed-aggregate executive trend report rather than raw metrics API access.

Unique bug: coach availability calendar shows date shifted by one day specifically for members west of the international date line - a distinct date-boundary defect, not a general timezone/notification-timing issue like the APAC reminder bug.
Unique, low-priority feature request for one-click facility-level breakdown in engagement reporting; distinct ask from BI API access or department cost breakdown on invoices.
Unique feature request for a read-only 'Auditor' admin role with full visibility and no write access.

Both describe the identical gap: no bulk-reassignment path for moving a departing coach's caseload to new coach(es), forcing tedious one-at-a-time manual reassignment. Same trigger scenario (coach departure) and same missing capability.
Unique bug: mobile app resets notification preferences to all-on after every app update, silently re-subscribing opted-out users.

Unique feature request for a privacy-preserving, suppression-thresholded, aggregate org-level wellbeing/participation trend report for executives - distinct from raw BI/API metrics access requests since it explicitly requires anonymization/suppression and rejects a solution built from private session-note extraction.
Unique bug: search results remain stale for ~10 minutes after a team rename or member team-move, while direct navigation reflects changes immediately.
Unique bug: SMS 2FA codes to Canadian mobile numbers arrive after the code's validity window expires, across all three major Canadian carriers, while US numbers are unaffected.
Unique feature request for per-department cost/seat breakdown on invoices to support multi-department billing allocation.
Unique bug: iOS universal links from notification emails open a web login page instead of deep-linking into the installed, authenticated app; Android is unaffected.
Unique bug: PingFederate-federated SSO users are hard-locked almost exactly 24 hours after login regardless of the shorter configured Ping session lifetime, requiring manual admin unlock.

Unique feature request for a REST API to programmatically create/manage teams (org units) for automated provisioning - distinct from the aggregate engagement-metrics API requests, as this is about org-structure management, not analytics data export.
Unique bug: reactivated members lose visibility into their own pre-deactivation session notes, even though the underlying data remains intact for admins.
Unique, low-priority feature want for an at-a-glance manager view of captains behind on coaching sessions.

Unique bug: monthly session-count reports exclude all sessions (not just future ones) for members deactivated mid-period, based on deactivation status at report-run time rather than session timestamps, understating engagement totals.

Unique feature request for an automated nightly SFTP push of a usage/engagement CSV extract; customer explicitly states an API-pull or manual export would not satisfy this requirement, distinguishing it from the generic BI/API access requests (call-049#f0, call-086#f0, call-134#f2).
Unique bug: Outlook/Microsoft 365 Safe Links prefetching consumes single-use verification email tokens before the human clicks, producing a false 'expired' error specific to Outlook users.
Unique bug: rescheduling a session within 24 hours of the original slot deducts a second, undisclosed session credit in addition to the original.
Unique bug: member-to-coach in-app messages over ~2000 characters silently fail to deliver while showing 'sent' to the sender, with no error shown.
Unique, purely cosmetic bug: French-locale settings tooltip uses the wrong accent mark; no other candidate concerns localization typography.
Unique feature request for automatic release of a coach's calendar hold after a member no-show, after a grace window, to free up bookable time.

Unique bug: bulk CSV import rejects the entire file with a generic, misleading error when the header row has trailing whitespace - a distinct failure mode (whole-file rejection with opaque error) from the silent per-row dropping of non-Latin names in call-029#f0.

Unique feature request for a dry-run/validation mode for bulk CSV member import, raised as a follow-up to the header-whitespace bug but describing a distinct desired capability (pre-import validation), not the bug itself.

Unique feature request to support multi-language (Spanish/French) automated notification emails driven by per-member language preference, addressing an activation gap distinct from in-app/session localization which already works.
